skills.name: plot-newsletter
skills.description: Subscribe someone to the Plot digest or the app launch waitlist. Use only when the person has asked to be subscribed, with the address they gave you.

skills.name: plot-titles
skills.description: Link to a film or TV show's page on Plot. Use when you want to point someone at a title on theplot.tv, or to check what Plot publishes about one.

skills.name: plot-whats-on
skills.description: Read Plot's What's On recommendations, its editorial guide to what is worth watching now. Use when someone asks what to watch, or what is new on streaming.
